confidence_notes: Meal, beer and cappuccino anchors use Palma's aggregated price index updated 4 June 2026. Cocktail and wine glass are estimated from their usual local price relationship to draft beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates and especially season-sensitive; no accommodation prices were searched.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used; food and drink estimates use Palma-specific aggregated prices, while accommodation is estimated from general knowledge of Palma's tourist market.
